content.title: Rosalía Enters ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 and the First Look Is Wild
content.text: The Spanish art-pop singer steps into a nightclub performer role in the darker new chapter of the series, appearing in the first trailer with a striking visual turn Set to premiere on April 12, 2026, on HBO Max, the new season promises a darker, more mature chapter for the series. Screenshot from HBO Max/YouTubeThe third season of Euphoria is about to arrive soon, and so far, the biggest takeaway from the first look of the series is the surprising acting debut of Spanish art-pop singer-songwriter Rosalía, as seen in the latest trailer that dropped on March 31. Set to premiere on April 12, 2026, on HBO Max, the new season promises a darker, more mature chapter for the series, with characters evolving from high school drama to the high-stakes situations of adulthood. In the newly released trailer, Rosalía appears as Magick, a stripper working at a nightclub called the “Silver Slipper.” The musician-turned-actress notably appears in one scene wearing a dramatic orthopedic neck brace adorned with crystals, performing on a strip pole.Creator and director Sam Levinson mentioned in a recent Vogue interview how he cast Rosalía immediately after an impressive audition. “She’s a great character. Funny, tough, emotional. I also love her accent. She was perfect for the part,” he says. Rosalía filmed her scenes for the latest season while simultaneously finishing her album Lux, which was released in November 2025.Recommended VideoIn This Article:Rosalía
